Root `pom.xml` is a Maven parent (`pom`) aggregating `ecommerce-common` and services: `user-service`, `product-service`, `inventory-service`, `cart-service`, `order-service`, `payment-service`, `shipping-service`. Layout: `<module>/src/main/java`, `<module>/src/main/resources` (`application.yml`), `<module>/src/test/java`; root: `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`. Prereqs: Java 21, Maven 3.9+, Docker.

Commands: `mvn clean package`; `mvn -pl user-service -am package`; `mvn -pl user-service spring-boot:run`; `java -jar user-service/target/user-service-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar`; `docker compose up --build`; `mvn test`; `mvn -pl order-service test`.

Use standard Java formatting with 4‑space indentation and one public class per file. Packages: `com.example.ecommerce.<service>` (`controller`, `entity`, `repository`, `service`). Controllers: `UserController`, `/api/...`; entities: `User`, `OrderItem`; repositories: Spring Data JPA `UserRepository`. Variables/methods `lowerCamelCase`; constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`. Prefer Lombok and shared `ecommerce-common` types (`ApiResponse`). Use JUnit 5 and Spring Boot testing support (`spring-boot-starter-test`); tests `*Test`/`*IT`.

Follow Conventional Commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`; include module scope. PRs: summary, affected modules, API examples, schema/config notes; ensure module tests pass before merging. Do not commit secrets; prefer environment variables. DB defaults: `docker-compose.yml`, `jdbc:mysql://mysql:3306/ecommerce`, user/password `ecommerce`.
